jobs_results.title: Senior Marketing Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Hi there!
We are Semrush, a global IT company developing our own product - a platform for digital marketers. New stars are born here, so don’t miss your chance. This is our Senior Marketing Project Manager role for idea generators, planning geniuses, and natural-born analysts.

Tasks in the role
• Plan and execute projects from scratch with a self-starter mentality.
• Develop an integrated marketing communications plan and craft the appropriate mix of channels and objectives.
• Own launch timeline, foresee dependencies, and drive cross-functional teams to meet deadlines.
• Identify, prioritize, mitigate, and plan contingencies to overcome roadblocks related to a given project.
• Partner with a peer group of cross-functional leads to ensure channel-level strategies deliver on campaign goals.
• Maintain a boundary-less concept of ownership and assume responsibility for connecting the dots between all aspects related to a project.
• Communicate fluently between executive-level strategy... and tactical execution details.
• Set and pursue KPIs at the campaign level as well as channel level to hold all activities accountable for success.
• Perform ongoing campaign performance analysis to make recommendations and optimizations across Paid, Earned, and Owned channels.
• Lead all internal campaign communications, from briefings to reporting.
• Liaise with creative production teams (internal and external) to create best-in-class assets on time and on budget

jobs_results.title: Junior Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
Description Media.Monks is looking for an ambitious Junior Project Manager to help coordinate projects for an iconic automotive brand across video, print and digital. We are looking for someone who is keen to become hyper-skilled in managing projects, external agencies, and clients, while learning how to safeguard stellar quality and processes.

Role & Responsibilities• Work as part of our fast-growing team and wear multiple hats to help your local team get projects completed.
• Support the day-to-day tasks of running projects: putting together crystal clear briefings and coordinating teams.
• Liaise with the media agency and gather all relevant specs, deadlines, and requirements.
• Be the glue between client, media, external agencies, local creative teams and central production hubs.
• Where possible, manage client relations and communications. Take meeting minutes, outline action steps and debrief the broader team.
• Responsible for updating scopes and quotes where needed.
• Source... assets from the client’s DAM, log usage rights, and organise project files and documentation for creative and production teams.
• Keep a close eye on quality and make sure all assets delivered to the client fit the original brief.

Requirements• 1-2 years of experience coordinating projects and/or teams. Preferably in production or creative agencies but this is not a must.
• Experience with fast-paced work environments and cross-cultural teams.
• Clear and strong communication skills in English, and your local language.
• Desire to learn fast across several integrated production streams and broaden your experience.
• Team player and self-starter with an unbreakable positive mindset.
• People enjoy working with you and you enjoy coordinating teams.
• Humble, open to feedback, and proactive in seeking ways to develop when time allows.
• Ambitious, gritty and resilient.
• High-quality standards

#LI-NB1

About Media.Monks:

Media.Monks is the purely digital operating brand of S4Capital plc that connects 8,600+ digital natives across one global team. We are united by a mission to shift industries forward and pave the path towards ambitious outcomes so our clients and our people can realize their full potential for growth. Our unified model combines solutions in media, data, social, platforms, studio, experience, brand and technology services to help our clients continuously reinvent themselves throughout increasingly rapid cycles of disruption. Our efforts to shape culture, build innovative technologies and unlock the future of growth have earned recognition from numerous esteemed panels: we maintain a constant presence on Adweek’s Fastest Growing lists (2019-22), regular recognition at Cannes Lions, inclusion in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players (2020-23), the title of Webby Production Company of the Year (2021-23), a record number of FWAs, and have earned a spot on Newsweek’s Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces 2023. Together, these achievements solidify our experience in digital innovation, excellence in craft, and commitment to personal growth.

While we continue to grow our teams, please be mindful of fraudulent job postings and recruiting activities that may use our company name and information. Please be mindful to protect your personal information, especially your national identification number, and bank account information during a recruiting process. While Media.Monks may reach out to potential candidates via LinkedIn, we will always ask applicants to apply through our website (https://media.monks.com/careers) and will never ask for payment or bank account information during the recruitment process.

Disclaimer: • Responsible for resourcing and implementing security controls for your teams processes and systems
• Responsible that all your personnel apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy

jobs_results.title: Program Manager
jobs_results.via: via ZF Jobs - ZF Friedrichshafen AG
jobs_results.description:
Req ID 68561 Vigo, Spain

We are looking for a new colleague to strengthen our Program Management Team in Vigo, Spain.

Main accountabilities, responsabilities and deliverables:
• Lead and manage the project teams and main customer contact partner for the project during execution phases (from kick off untill closure).
• Support acquisition activities on a case-by-case basis as agreed with program management lead.
• Responsible for preparing and rework the total project plan including time and budget planning, in accordance to GDPEP requirements.
• Responsible for meeting both customer and ZF LIFETEC milestones, key process indicators (profit, quality, time) and interacting with customer through specific interfaces.
• Providing regular project status reports to customer and ZF LIFETEC management.
• Profit responsibility for product/investments/tooling and development/budget planning and total project cost control.
• Guarantee the updated information availabitlity about project, manage... risks, issues and action plans to recover deviations.
• Management of modifications during the development process.
• Organizing and performin GDPEP phase exit reviews, participating in customer audits, customer assessments, IATF audits.

Required skills and experience / main competences:
• Engineering degree or experience in automotive industry as Program Manager.
• Between 2 or 3 years working experience as Program Manager, preferred in automotive industry.
• Competency in ZF LIFETEC product design fundamentals, automotive APQP processes, PPAP processes, manufacturing knowledge and financial management basics.
• Microsoft Project user (or other similar tool).
• Preferred PMP certification through PMI, Price 2.
• Fluent English level, other optional languages (French, German) as a plus.
• Good communication, leadership and teamwork skills, negotiation, problem solving abilities and a customer/stakeholder service orientation.
• Risk management, Financial, Quality, Lean Mfg knowledge.

Be part of our ZF team as Program Manager SWS and apply now!

Contact

Elena Mallo

jobs_results.title: Project Manager - Adobe CRM (EN)
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

Exciting Opportunity:

No Spanish? No problem! Join Us in Madrid for the International CRM Hub!

We're thrilled to announce an incredible opportunity for our employees to join a special project program in Madrid, Spain. At Publicis Groupe, we believe in fostering growth, exploration, and collaboration, and this initiative embodies those values perfectly.

Project Program Details:
• Duration: 6 weeks, 3 months or permanently (up to you!)
• Start Date: Mid-April (the assignment will be confirmed the week before)
• Deadline for applications: 17th March 2024
• Language: C1 English is a must. Spanish is not required for this opportunity.
• Transition Team: A dedicated team will assist in facilitating the transition while we hire the permanent team. This includes accommodation, transportation, labor advisorship,… (if you choose the 3-month period, you will have a monthly flight back home)
• Permanent Move: For those considering a permanent relocation to Madrid, this is... definitely an option! You can transfer to Publicis Groupe Spain. Daily Paella is not included in the deal.
• Requirements: EU work permit and the ability to move to Madrid on a short notice 😊

Job Description

Overseeing the day-to-day operations and ensuring that the operations runs efficiently and effectively. Coordinate and manage operational activities to achieve the goals and objectives according to markets needs.

What are the responsabilities?

Ensure operation:
• Privileged interlocutor of the IT&Data CRM teams .
• Make sure partner’s SLA are respected
• Process & Quality improvement
• Main contact for Country request not related to campaigns

Qualifications
• Excellent technic knowledge of Adobe Campaign Classic tool is required
• Understanding of business needs
• A datamining sensitivity
• Fluent in English (written & spoken)
• Spanish is not required for this role

Additional Information

Why join us? Because we offer reasons such as:

🌟 Flexible Benefits: Enjoy more than just work with flexible compensation including meal vouchers, health insurance, transportation, and more.

🚀 Growth Opportunities: Advance in your professional career by working with major clients and gaining access to specialized training programs.

📚 Online Training: Through our artificial intelligence platform, access countless courses. Additionally, free English classes for groups of up to 6 people with native teachers.

🌍 Work from Anywhere: Telecommute for 6 weeks from over 100 countries (including Spain) with our #WorkYourWorld program.

🎉 Special Days Off: Celebrate your holidays, birthdays, and Advertising Day with additional days off.

✨ Work-Life Balance: Enjoy a hybrid model with up to two days working from home and intensive summer hours.

Here at Publicis Groupe, we are committed to building a culturally diverse workforce and therefore strongly encourages applications from underrepresented groups. We are committed to equality of opportunity and welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of their background: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, marital status on any individual´s status in any group or class protected by law.

If you have any reasonable adjustment needs arising from a disability or medical condition to fully participate in the recruitment process, please discuss this with the recruiter who contacts you

jobs_results.title: Marketing Services Project Manager Intern
jobs_results.description:
Back Market is the world’s leading refurbished electronics marketplace with a team of 650 people, powering operations in 21 countries (and counting!).

Named one of the World's Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company in 2019 and again in 2021, our mission is simple: empowering people to consume tech sustainably by offering folks a high quality, accessible, and more eco-friendly alternative to buying new electronics. Why? Refurbished tech helps lower our collective environmental impact. We have indeed contributed to avoid the production of more than 1,000,000 tons of CO2e worldwide since our launch in 2014.

Be part of an exciting and growing international adventure that will change the way the world consumes tech.

We are looking for an intern to join the Marketing Services team for 6 months.

The Marketing Services team aims at creating & developing projects that change consumer perception of refurbished electronics, demonstrating their value and reliability. The internship will... focus on the Marketing Services stream "New offers", developing new offers that build trust and affordability in refurbished tech, particularly through partnerships with telecommunications companies and premium offers that remove the uncertainty associated with refurbished tech.
Your Mission (If You Accept It): 🥇
• Participate in the project management, coordinating with internal stakeholders and external partners
• Prepare reports and analyze data to understand the performance of our projects and make recommendations for improvement
• Help with the communication across internal and external teams
• Contribute to strategic research on current and future offers (benchmark, competitors analysis)
You’re At The Right Place If: ⭐
• Bachelor/Master degree in Business, Marketing or Engineering
• You have some experience in project management: you have already participated in planning projects and supported their monitoring
• You have good communication skills and like to collaborate with cross-functional teams
• You like to analyze data and problem-solving
• You have a customer-centric mindset: you are keen to understand customer needs and preferences, and try to use their feedback to suggest improvements
• You are a Tech savvy and would like to discover more about the refurbished tech
• You speak French and English fluently
About the internship: ⚡️
• Starting date: July/August 2024
• Duration: 6 months
• Full-time role (35H/week)
• Location: Barcelona, Spain
• Contract: You must have an internship agreement provided by your current school
Recruitment process: 🚦
• HR Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist (30 min)
• Technical test (home assignment)
• Skills and Team fit interview with the direct manager and another person in the team (1h)
WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

- A meaningful job: through hard work, you will help avoid thousands of tons of electronic waste and fight against planned obsolescence. It counts!
- An attractive salary, multiple benefits (meal tickets, health insurance, etc...), internal events, etc…
- Be in an environment where you can make a difference: you will have the freedom to innovate and adopt new ideas!
- A booming scale-up: our environment is rapidly growing in Europe, the USA and in Asia!
- We embrace work life balance which includes flexible working hours and the opportunity to work from home.
- A lot of fun: you will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, open-minded and friendly environment.

Back Market is an Equal Opportunity Employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation.

Back Market is helping to address one of the biggest challenges of our time: climate change. We take this so seriously that we were awarded status as a “Société à Mission”, or company with a social mission, by the French government. We know we can’t tackle a global problem without a globally representative team so we are committed to embedding diversity, equity and inclusion principles in every aspect of our organization. But more importantly, being One Loving & Free Spirited Tribe is in our DNA as it is one of the five foundational values of our company since we got started way back in 2014. We are committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We know our lofty goals cannot be reached unless everyone has a seat at the table along with the resources and opportunity to grow

jobs_results.title: Project Management Office / PMO Manager
jobs_results.company_name: Radisson Hotel Group, Madrid Office-Information Technology
jobs_results.description:
Mission:
The Project Management Office (PMO) manager mission is to introduce, maintain & measure a consistent approach to managing projects. It oversees the administration of projects to ensure support of the standards, methodology and technology defined by the IT organization.

Role purpose:
Primary role of the PMO manager is to apply a set of supporting activities for the consumption of both the Project Management teams as well as governance & reporting for Radisson’s IT senior management, in line with the goals set by the Transformation Office Lead. This will include application of practical management controls that support improved project/organizational performance.

Responsibilities:
Play a key role in implementing the company’s project management governance and methodologies for the project
• Drive adoption of best practices among project management community
• Own documentation strategy
• Provide key project analysis to key stakeholders
• Maintain and update project management... controlling & reporting tools; deliver senior-level status reports to the steering committees
• Maintain documentation for projects including tracking of risks, action logs and project deliverables (as needed)
• Assure initial quality on received data inputs based on given guidelines
• Report on project performance and KPIs
• Provide other PMO support to project managers such as vendor & contract management, cost management, resource management.
• Strategy: Define and drive the IT project management best practices within the Corporate domains with the Transformation Office Lead to support the 5 Year Plan initiative and EMMA – RHG’s Corporate Global Platform.
• Solution Design: Ensure that the internal and external Business Relationship Managers and Project managers adopt to the solution design processes and templates defined by the Transformation/Project Management Office.

RHG’s Corporate ideal PMO shows:
• Ability to connect the dots through a Stakeholder’s eyes with a keen ability to sift through the clutter of data to articulate the business strategy and the alignment of prioritized IT initiatives to achieve it faster, more efficiently and with a measurable outcome.
• Strong consulting, facilitation and negotiation experience, preferably with external customers.
• Succinct executive level verbal and written business communication in non-IT lingo.
• Analytical skills to measure and drive key business decisions on process & systems to enable the overall company success.
• Corporate Industry knowledge or similar one
• Sound knowledge of Project Management methodology and function
• Ability to drive multiple program stream status updates, action and RAID logs
• Excellent attention to details, accuracy and analytical mindset
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills
• Strong program/project management skills

Requirements:
Preferred but not required bachelor's degree in computer science or information systems
Minimum experience: +5 years in Global / Area / Regional IT Management role, +5 years relevant experience working in capacity of a PMO / Project Manager, +2 years experience on IT vendor management
At least 10 years of multi-disciplined IT experience including:
• Proven experience in a PMO role
• Experience implementing new project management practices or reviewing / improving existing processes and templates
• Experience in software development or implementation project life cycle
• Experience in large sophisticated IT organizations with high volume/high transaction environment.
• Regional/Global management experience and teaming experience including line management.
• Experience working in a fast-past environment with a strong ability to show initiative
• Experience in writing documents, preparing process workflows, doing professional ppt decks/papers/minutes to a high standard
• Advanced user level experience with MS Office (Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
• Exposure to both change management and business analysis
• Strong in processing complex tasks quickly working with Agile methodologies
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills.
• Strong program/project management skills
Soft skills:
• Making customers more successful: Customer-oriented mind-set, capable of maintaining relationships & build trust at director level & above across multiple stakeholders, goal-oriented individual.
• Shaping direction: strategic oriented individual, capable of envisioning, developing, aligning and communicating the processes and tools to execute successful projects and initiatives
• Performance: High performance individual, who takes responsibilities & deliver towards them, by coordinating effort and aligning resources to achieve objectives.
• Communication: Clear communication view, able to adapt it to the audience (technical, manager, executive), internal or external), in a variety of format presentation settings: one to one, small and large groups, with peers etc.
• Change management: Able to act as a change agent, initiating, sponsoring, enabling and driving transformative changes of strategic significance. Help drive the deployment and adoption of the industry best practices across the organization.
English at negotiation level as a minimum.

#LI-DM1

Compensation: To be discussed

• Maintain documentation for projects including tracking of risks, action logs and project deliverables (as needed)
• Assure initial quality on received data inputs based on given guidelines
• Report on project performance and KPIs
• Provide other PMO support to project managers such as vendor & contract management, cost management, resource management.
• Strategy: Define and drive the IT project management best practices within the Corporate domains with the Transformation Office Lead to support the 5 Year Plan initiative and EMMA – RHG’s Corporate Global Platform.
• Solution Design: Ensure that the internal and external Business Relationship Managers and Project managers adopt to the solution design processes and templates defined by the Transformation/Project Management Office.

• Ability to connect the dots through a Stakeholder’s eyes with a keen ability to sift through the clutter of data to articulate the business strategy and the alignment of prioritized IT initiatives to achieve it faster, more efficiently and with a measurable outcome.
• Strong consulting, facilitation and negotiation experience, preferably with external customers.
• Succinct executive level verbal and written business communication in non-IT lingo.
• Analytical skills to measure and drive key business decisions on process & systems to enable the overall company success.
• Corporate Industry knowledge or similar one
• Sound knowledge of Project Management methodology and function
• Ability to drive multiple program stream status updates, action and RAID logs
• Excellent attention to details, accuracy and analytical mindset
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills
• Strong program/project management skills

Requirements:
Preferred but not required bachelor's degree in computer science or information systems
Minimum experience: +5 years in Global / Area / Regional IT Management role, +5 years relevant experience working in capacity of a PMO / Project Manager, +2 years experience on IT vendor management
At least 10 years of multi-disciplined IT experience including:
• Proven experience in a PMO role
• Experience implementing new project management practices or reviewing / improving existing processes and templates
• Experience in software development or implementation project life cycle
• Experience in large sophisticated IT organizations with high volume/high transaction environment.
• Regional/Global management experience and teaming experience including line management.
• Experience working in a fast-past environment with a strong ability to show initiative
• Experience in writing documents, preparing process workflows, doing professional ppt decks/papers/minutes to a high standard
• Advanced user level experience with MS Office (Excel, Access, PowerPoint)
• Exposure to both change management and business analysis
• Strong in processing complex tasks quickly working with Agile methodologies
• Ability to deliver through matrix organizations.
• Solid & extensive vendor management skills.
• Strong program/project management skills
Soft skills:

English at negotiation level as a minimum.

jobs_results.title: Certification Project Manager
jobs_results.description:
About Us

Always open. Our code, our culture, our opportunities. Leading open innovation without limits. We are SUSE.

SUSE is a global leader in innovative, reliable and secure enterprise open source solutions, including SUSE Linux Enterprise (SLE), Rancher and NeuVector. More than 60% of the Fortune 500 rely on SUSE to power their mission-critical workloads, enabling them to innovate everywhere – from the data center to the cloud, to the edge and beyond. SUSE puts the “open” back in open source, collaborating with partners and communities to give customers the agility to tackle innovation challenges today and the freedom to evolve their strategy and solutions tomorrow.

We are open in our roots and open in our approach, striving to be the most trusted open innovator in the World. Openness extends beyond our technology. Our vibrant community thrives on diversity and connectivity without borders.
Certification Project Manager

Job Description

As a Certification Project Manager, you... will have the opportunity to meaningfully impact how our organization scales by attaining certification compliance of SUSE products portfolio in accordance with industry production standards in security and conformance defined by worldwide established bodies such as ISO, NIST, BSI, PCI, as well as other national certification bodies. Join industry-leading professionals to ensure that our processes, infrastructure, and products are designed, operated, maintained and protected in accordance with these certifications and security standards as it applies to SUSE. This role reports to SUSE’s Head of Solutions Certification and will work closely with Engineering, Product Management, Legal, Pre-Sales and Marketing.

Summary:

You are responsible for establishing and persistently maintaining certified production compliance status for portfolio of chosen SUSE products and their relevant certifications. You drive the design and implementation of corresponding compliance frameworks, define delivery milestones and track their progress.

Responsibilities:
• Driving certification cycles projects for our enterprise products and organization
• Defining milestones and tracking their progress
• Liaising common grounds across Engineering, PM, consultants, and partners
• Coordinating compliance requirements across different teams
• Organizing events and workshops necessary for relevant knowledge sharing
• Organizing cycle process documentation and keeping it in accurate up to date state
• Communicating with certification labs and authorities, primarily in Germany and the US
• Filing and tracking relevant application paperwork
• Communication with external and internal customers

Candidate Profile:
• 5+ years of total experience in software product development industry
• Minimum 1 year of which in managing product and organization certification compliance to security, conformance, or safety standards from ISO, CCRA / Common Criteria, NIST / FIPS or other standardisation bodies
• Strong skills in process handling and documentation frameworks, such as MS/Open/Libre Office, Confluence/Jira, etc
• Good knowledge about certification bodies (e.g. BSI, NIST, NIAP, ANSSI) and their typical requirements
• Passion for organized paperwork and skills of keeping large sets of information pieces in systematic manner
• Project management level in GPM/PMP/IPMA (minimal ‘D’, ‘C’ or ‘B’ is a plus) or equivalent
• Excellent communication and 'soft' skills
• Excellent communication level of English (German language skills is a plus)
• Familiarity with Linux operating system

What makes us different:
• You will find and can connect to highly skilled engineers at SUSE
• We provide many different products and endless opportunities to learn
• We help our employees to develop
• We work with, support, maintain, and advocate open-source!
• You can work with and within an international team
• Our working hours are as flexible as can be any team-work from home!
• We organize regular events (hackathons, workshops, outdoor events, etc) to build up relationships and friendship within and across teams
• At SUSE the opinion of the employee matters!
• SUSE is a growing company, with great products, a culture that fosters openness and friendship, and where many opportunities exist
• SUSE has more than two decades of experience in maintaining industrial grade security and bespoke product compliance to make our products outstanding

If you are successful for this position you'll have to pass pre-employment checks before joining us. The content of these checks may vary by country.

Job
Quality

What We Offer

We empower you to be bold, driving your career to create the future you want. We celebrate and reward your achievements. 

SUSE is a dynamic environment that is evolving rapidly, thus requiring agility, strong entrepreneurship and an open mind.

This is a compelling opportunity for the right person to join us as we continue to scale and prosper.  

If you’re a big thinker, obsessed by execution and thrive in a dynamic environment in which you can tangibly create a lasting legacy, then please apply now! 

We give you the freedom to be yourself. You will work in a global community of unique individuals – like you – with different backgrounds, talents, skills and perspectives. A truly open community where everyone is welcome, has a voice and is encouraged to reach their full potential regardless of age, gender, race, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or any other characteristics.  

Sounds like the right fit for you? Click Apply to submit your resume. A recruiter will contact you if your skills match our current or any future positions. In the meantime, stay updated on the latest SUSE news and job vacancies by joining our Talent Community.

SUSE Values
• We are passionate about customers 
• We are respectful and inclusive 
• We are empowered and accountable  
• We are trustworthy and act with integrity 
• We are collaborative 
• We are SUSE

jobs_results.title: CX Project Manager (TIP2024)
jobs_results.description:
Are you a fresh graduate looking to boost your career in a dynamic and innovative multinational?

Join our Talent Incubator Program and start your career journey at Schneider Electric!

Who we are and what we do.

In Schneider Electric, we are the leading digital partner in sustainability and efficiency for businesses, communities, and individuals. Our goal is for everyone to be able to make the most of our energy and resources through the integration of processes, software, Big Data, and cutting-edge energy technologies that enable integrated management of buildings, industries, and cities.

We are part of the TOP5 in the ranking of the best companies to work for in Spain 2023, present in over 110 countries with a diverse and disruptive team of over 135,000 people.

What You Can Expect.

We have created an innovative program including many learning, training, and disruptive experiences, with tailored content regarding sustainability and digital transformation, and focusing on... launching your professional career with us.

From the first day 1 an Agile, Transformative, and Inspiring program awaits you, where you’ll combine your work hands-on work experience (being actively integrated into the day-to-day activities of your teams) with training and mentoring, and the development of a project sponsored by a member of our management committee.

We are looking for people like you, who are willing to embrace this challenge and develop the potential you have within.

Position title: CX Project Manager

Where will you work?

CS&Q is responsible for managing and improving every interaction throughout a customer's journey with Schneider. This includes understanding the customer's needs, preferences, and pain points throughout their journey, and then designing, implementing, and monitoring strategies and initiatives to enhance our overall customer experience. It also involves ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations.

This position is crucial for aligning customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives. Collaborating closely with various teams and leaders provides the opportunity to influence decision-making processes that directly impact customer perception and satisfaction. Understanding customer needs and preferences enables advocating for customer-centric solutions that not only enhance the overall customer experience but also drive business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty. Additionally, ensuring that products or services meet established standards and customer expectations through processes to identify, address, and prevent issues in order to maintain high quality standards.

What will you do?
• Gathering and analyzing customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement; Developing and implementing customer-centric processes across various touchpoints; Collaborating with other departments to ensure a consistent and seamless customer experience; Sharing and promoting global customer experience programs within the organization;
• Measuring and sharing customer satisfaction KPIs with the organization;
• Driving initiatives to increase customer satisfaction, retention, and value;
• Implementing corrective actions when issues are identified;
• Communicating with customers about problems and solutions;
• Training staff in quality practices;
• Advocating for the customer within the organization to ensure their needs are prioritized in decision-making.

What will you learn?

This position will allow you to develop a holistic understanding of customer experience, business, and strategic alignment, while enhancing your interpersonal and professional skills.

Communication: Improving communication skills through interactions with diverse teams, leaders, and customers. Strategic Thinking: Learning to align customer experience initiatives with the company's strategic objectives and contribute to decision-making processes. Customer-Centric Mindset: Understanding and advocating for customer needs, preferences, and solutions. Collaboration: Working closely with different teams and leaders to influence customer perception and satisfaction. Business Acumen: Gaining insights into how customer experience impacts business growth, customer retention, and long-term loyalty.

What You Bring:
• Fresh graduate in Management or Engineering
• Be able to start a 1-year program in May 2024.
• Fluent in English and Spanish, written and spoken. Portuguese is a plus.
• Analytical skills and intermediate level of Excel (Basic – Pivots and formulas, Macros - is a plus).
• Basic/intermediate level in Power Point. Knowledge of Agile methodologies and Design Thinking is a plus.
• Collaborative and curious, Active listening, Problem-solving skills, and innovative. Empathy and proactivity.

What we offer?

· An open-ended contract with a very competitive compensation package

· A unique experience specially designed for your learning and development

· The opportunity to meet others talented workers colleagues and develop your network around through activities and bootcamps

· The development of a Game Changer project with Agile methodologies.

· Depending on the position, rotations into different teams inside or outside of your department for 1 month or more

· Careers opportunities

What is the application process?

Step 1 – Online Application

Step 2 - Online recorded video interview

Step 3 – Online Competencies test

Step 4 – Online Escape Room

Step 5 - Online Interview

Places are filled on a first-come, first-served basis. We would recommend early application to avoid disappointment!.

Benefits.
• We adapt to you! :
• With our flexible schedule, you'll have the freedom to adjust your working hours to accommodate your personal needs and responsibilities.

💻 We understand the benefits of working from home. With our hybrid work plan, you can enjoy working hours from the comfort of your own home.

🏝 Need more time to relax and unwind? With our Holy Pack, you can purchase additional vacation days to recharge whenever you need it most.

📅 Celebrate holidays your way! With Floating Holidays, you can exchange public holidays for other days that better suit your plans and personal preferences.

🧘‍♂️ Need extra time to explore new experiences or focus on personal projects? With the Sabbatical Pack, you can request up to 2 months of additional unpaid leave.

💞 We value the importance of family and want to support you in all aspects of your life. Our Global Family Leave Policy provides flexible paid conditions for when you need it most, whether you're about to become a parent, need time to overcome a loss, or care for a loved one.

· We take care of you! :

📱 With access to the health and wellness platform Wellwo, you and up to 5 people of your choice can enjoy virtual medical care and 24/7 psychological support, as well as access to nutritional advice, guided classes, and much more!

🏄‍♂️ From attending dance classes to booking a hotel spa, we offer a partnership with AJ by Gympass, giving you access to a network of thousands of gyms and sports centers, so you can keep your body active in the way you prefer.

🩺 Your well-being is our priority. You'll have medical services available at your workplace for close attention to any medical needs.

· We empower you! :

🎯 With Open Talent Market, our AI-driven professional development platform, you can connect with job opportunities, projects, and mentors at Schneider Electric globally.

🤑 We offer you the opportunity to become a shareholder of Schneider Electric and share in our achievements through our employee share ownership program.

🙌 We celebrate talent and success offor all with our recognition program, where you can give and receive points for your accomplishments and redeem them for gift cards at your favorite stores.

💗 You'll have life insurance for your protection.

💰 We offer a Flexible Compensation Plan, where you can choose from a variety of options such as health insurance, meal vouchers, childcare vouchers, transportation vouchers, training, and more.

🛒 As part of our #SEGreatPeople, you'll have access to an online store with Schneider Electric products at exclusive prices and super discounts.

🎁 With Club Schneider, you'll enjoy special discounts at your favorite stores, restaurants, travel agencies, and other external services.

💚 Participate in company-sponsored volunteer programs to contribute to our community and make a positive impact in your surroundings.

Disclaimer
• We seek out and reward people for putting the customer first, being disruptingve to the status quo, embracing different perspectives, continuously learning, and acting like owners. We want our employees to reflect the diversity of the communities in which we operate. We welcome people as they are, creating an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity are seen as a real value for the company. We’re looking for people with a passion for success — on the job and beyond

Why us?

Schneider Electric is leading the digital transformation of energy management and automation. Our technologies enable the world to use energy in a safe, efficient and sustainable manner. We strive to promote a global economy that is both ecologically viable and highly productive.

€25.7bn global revenue

137 000+ employees in 100+ countries

45% of revenue from IoT

5% of revenue devoted for R&D

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled

It is the policy of Schneider Electric to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct. Concerning agencies: Schneider Electric does not accept unsolicited resumes and will not be responsible for fees related to such

jobs_results.title: SAP Senior Project Manager and Migration Specialist
jobs_results.description:
As project manager you will manage and lead SAP related projects with different levels of complexity. Taking part in our major S4/HANA initiative. You will build and evaluate the project regarding time, budget, quality, and customer satisfaction. You will hand over the project results into daily business. You have profound experience communicating complex concepts to your team and partners on different levels.

You Will
• Leads the operating entities (OEs) and delivery teams throughout the implementation project cycle including planning, execution, testing, migration, and cutover of SAP GRP projects and roll outs in Allianz.
• Develop project scope, including timeline and financials and ensuring technical feasibility.
• Partners with various functional and technical teams within Allianz Technology such as Ariba, IMA, ABAP, Basis, SAP Authorization.
• Partners with Financial Transformation team in ensuring the target design aligns with the implementation standards and group reporting... requirements.
